tools.name: whoami
tools.description:
The connected Cuddler account: its plan, credit balance and daily credit allowance (the balance is what limits spending; `budget` is null unless a daily limit for this connection is set, and then says what is left of it today), what the user allowed when connecting (`permissions.create`: add reference images; `permissions.spend`: spend credits on images and videos), and which kinds of generation are open for the account (`features`). Free; changes nothing.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The image and video models this account can use, with their limits (lengths, aspect ratios, resolutions, reference images) and exact prices in credits: `pricing` lists every video length at every resolution, and image models show `creditsPerImage`. A model with `available: false` is not in this account's plan or not open for it yet. Free; changes nothing.

tools.name: list_my_characters
tools.description:
The user's own Cuddler characters, newest first, `limit` (default 24) per page; pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Each has an `id` for get_character, a name and a picture. Only characters cleared for all ages are listed; the rest stay in the Cuddler app.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description:
One of the user's characters by `id`: its name, `appearance` (the sentences of its description about how it looks), its main picture and its extra reference pictures. To put the character in a new image or video, pass `{ "characterId": id }` in `references` (its main picture is used) and write its appearance into the prompt.

tools.name: quote_image
tools.description: Prices one image and runs every check that could refuse it (plan and model, resolution, content rules, reference images) without generating or charging anything. `quote.credits` is the price: show it to the user and wait for their go-ahead, then pass it as `maxCredits` to create_image. `quote.width` × `quote.height` is the size that will actually render. `references` takes `{ "characterId": … }` for one of the user's characters (its main picture is used) or `{ "url": … }` for an image this account made (`image.url` from create_image) or uploaded (`reference.url` from finish_upload).

tools.name: create_image
tools.description:
Generates one image and saves it, private, to the user's Cuddler account. Spends the user's credits. Requires `maxCredits` (the price from quote_image; if the price is now higher, nothing is charged and the call is refused) and `idempotencyKey` (8–128 characters, one per image: repeating a call with the same key returns the same image without charging again). If generation fails after the charge, the credits are refunded. For several images, call it once per image with a different key each time. Takes the same `references` as quote_image. Call it only after the user has seen the price and said to go ahead: nothing else stops it before the balance does. If Cuddler asks for the user's approval, the call is refused with `confirmation_required` and an `approvalUrl` and nothing runs: give the user that link to approve it in their browser, then repeat the call with exactly the same arguments plus `approvalId`. Nothing is charged until then.

tools.name: quote_video
tools.description: Prices one video and runs every check that could refuse it (plan and model, length, content rules, reference images) without generating or charging anything. The prompt and reference images go to the video model as written, as a single shot: refer to reference images in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2… in the order given (with `imageMode: "first_frame"`, exactly one image is the opening frame and the prompt names none). `references` takes `{ "characterId": … }` for one of the user's characters (its main picture is used) or `{ "url": … }` for an image this account made (`image.url` from create_image) or uploaded (`reference.url` from finish_upload). `quote.credits` is the price: show it to the user and wait for their go-ahead, then pass it as `maxCredits` to create_video. Each quote uses part of a small per-account checking allowance, so quote once per request the user has settled on.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description:
Starts generating one video and saves it, private, to the user's Cuddler account; the user decides on Cuddler whether to publish it. Spends the user's credits. Requires `maxCredits` (the price from quote_video; if the price is now higher, nothing is charged and the call is refused) and `idempotencyKey` (8–128 characters, one per video: after a timeout, send the call again with the SAME key, which never charges twice). Returns at once with `status: "rendering"`; check it with get_video after `pollAfterSeconds`. A video that is still rendering needs no new one. Takes the same `references` as quote_video. Call it only after the user has seen the price and said to go ahead: nothing else stops it before the balance does. If Cuddler asks for the user's approval, the call is refused with `confirmation_required` and an `approvalUrl` and nothing runs: give the user that link to approve it in their browser, then repeat the call with exactly the same arguments plus `approvalId`. Nothing is charged until then.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description:
One of the user's videos by `id`: `status` (`rendering`, `ready` or `failed`), an estimated `progress`, and once ready the `videoUrl` and `posterUrl`; when it failed, the `failureReason` and, if it can be retried, the `retry` price. While it renders, `pollAfterSeconds` says when to check again. Checking never charges anything.

tools.name: retry_video
tools.description:
Generates a failed video again with its stored prompt and reference images, which are checked again first. The first retry of a failed video is free; later retries cost the video's price in credits. Requires `maxCredits`: the `retry.credits` from get_video (0 accepts only the free retry). A video the model itself refused (`failureReason: "provider_rejected"`, or `"reference_face_rejected"` / `"reference_not_registered"` when it read an image as a real person's face) has no retry: change the prompt or the images and create a new video. Call it only after the user has seen the price and said to go ahead: nothing else stops it before the balance does. If Cuddler asks for the user's approval, the call is refused with `confirmation_required` and an `approvalUrl` and nothing runs: give the user that link to approve it in their browser, then repeat the call with exactly the same arguments plus `approvalId`. Nothing is charged until then.

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: Download links for one of the user's ready videos: the video file and its poster, valid for about 10 minutes. By default the video is the original file. With `watermark: true` it is the same file as the Cuddler app's Save to device: the Cuddler.ai mark in the corner, plus the closing Cuddler card unless the user turned it off in the app (`watermarked: true` on that file) — use it when the user wants to post the video with Cuddler credited. The first watermarked request for a video can take up to about a minute while the file is made; if the answer says it is still being made (`watermark_rendering`), call again after a few seconds. Free.

tools.name: start_upload
tools.description: Step 1 of adding a reference image from a file (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MiB), for clients that can send files over HTTP: returns a signed `url` to PUT the raw bytes to, with exactly the returned `headers`. The link expires after about 10 minutes. Free.

tools.name: finish_upload
tools.description: Step 2, after the PUT: cleans the image (strips EXIF and location data, bounds its size), checks it against Cuddler's content rules and returns `reference.url`, for `references` when pricing or creating an image or a video. A refused image is deleted. Safe to repeat with the same `uploadId`. Free.
